result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but a few elements look visually broken or awkward, mainly around horizontally clipped content and the fixed bottom navigation overlapping the feed.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation appears to cover the restaurant feed content. The second restaurant image is cut off behind the nav bar, making the lower part of the card inaccessible or visually hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The category chip row shows a partially visible blank pill on the far right, which looks like a broken or accidentally clipped filter option.
issues.suggestion: Either hide overflow cleanly, show enough of the next chip to make it clear this is a horizontal carousel, or adjust spacing so no empty-looking partial chip appears.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third restaurant card and its text are clipped at the right edge, making the restaurant name and delivery information look cut off.
issues.suggestion: Use proper carousel snapping, consistent card widths, and text ellipsis within each card, or add enough right padding so partially visible cards look intentional.
